text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been raining since early this morning. The track is a complete mess, however…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Neither the condition of the track nor the looming eyes of the audience will faze me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All the effort we've poured into this… All the experience I've attained competing with my rivals…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: They give me strength and push me forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (My competition with Ryan at the Takarazuka Kinen stands out as a special moment.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Thanks to her fierce resolve, I am determined and ready!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I'll be the first of the Mejiro family to claim consecutive victories in the spring and autumn Tenno Sho!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The determination welling up in Mejiro McQueen's eyes begins to dance like a blazing fire!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your victory!
I'm looking forward to your victory!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. And I shall attain it with confidence and ease.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall live up to your expectations with all my spirit and might.
